title: Owner decides schedule, notice and quiet hours
goal: When NERV checks, how long before applying it warns, and when it never applies
acceptance: Check schedule (e.g. daily 03:00), notice lead time (e.g. 2 h), quiet hours, channels (Telegram and inbox) recorded in F-102
privacy: Local only; tests use invented bases, revisions and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-15: check daily at 20:00; notice at check time; apply at 03:00 unless the owner says wait ("aspetta"); never apply 08:00-23:00 (quiet hours); notice and result go to Telegram, the local inbox and web push. No actual: owner time not measured.
